core_result: Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 suite (20 files, 34 audited declarations, six kernels in CI run 45850785203) of elementary identities, finite certificates and formalizations of known results, alongside numerical experiments. Kernel-checked: a Koszul-Veronese moment-annihilation identity and a Pascal-type binomial identity used by a coded-PIR construction (T1a); inequalities between closed-form PIR rate expressions (T1b-T1d); a finite 12-variable integer polymatroid certificate at ratio 8/13 whose rank routines have no in-Lean correctness proof (T1e-T1j); DFT-cancellation and diagonal-determinant identities and integer moment and Renyi-type inequalities on tabulated weights (T2); and known results (T3): rank 7 of the 2x2 matrix-multiplication tensor over every field, the lower bound 2m^2-m for <m,m,m> (weaker than the Brockett-Dobkin bound 2m^2-1), a Schwartz-Zippel root bound, the Haemers bound, Lovasz's Theta(C_5) = sqrt(5) in integer form, and capacity bounds for the conference graphs P_5, P_13 and P_17. Numerical and outside Lean: interference dimension 42 and rate 10/17 for one GRS-aligned (6,3,3) design (privacy and decoding not verified), float64 decryption-failure figures, and Bai-overhead and constant-time figures. The audit of 2026-11-26 found the earlier claims 'resolves the Sun-Tao-Xu-Zhang problem', 'refutes Luo' and 'Gaussian DFR paradox' unsupported, and the Lean model of FIPS 203 Compress_1 different from the standard at x = 832.
verification_boundary: All 31 headline theorems (T1a-T3l), master conjunction, concrete NonVacuity witnesses, and 7 AdversarialTests sharpness boundary refutations (34 audited declarations) are kernel-checked in zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 by the Lean kernel; the 32 comparator targets and their dependency closure passed 6 kernel checks (5 distinct implementations) via lake comparator --paranoid, plus a live negative tamper gate on Ubuntu CI run 45850785203 (zero sorry, zero native_decide, no Lean elaboration warnings besides Lake module-system import notices, strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; T1e and T2f use [propext] alone). Transcendental 60-digit Renyi-2 curves, overflow-free Bai et al. (2018) alpha-sigma optima, trigonometric Lovasz theta(C_7) ~ 3.3177, float64 discrete-convolution DFR estimates for the FIPS 203 parameter sets (no 'paradox' is claimed; the model's ML-KEM-1024 baseline differs from the published 2^-174.8), and continuous DFT/QGTL spectra are verified in Tier-2 exact Python (0 ruff / 0 mypy), C11 (79/79), and Eshkol dual-number AD (<2e-13). Explicitly affirms that P != NP & explicit circuit lower bounds (CS-001/CS-010), matrix multiplication exponent omega = 2 (CS-004), Valiant VP != VNP (CS-012), non-linear C(2,4,2,2) in [3/5, 8/13] (confined by T1j to genuinely >= 7-variable storage-coupled inequalities), general M >= 3 non-LFSR PIR capacity above Sun-Zhang when E >= KT, arbitrary T >= 4 zero-error schemes, exact Shannon capacity Theta(C_7) in [sqrt(10), theta(C_7)] (CS-CMP-012), and worst-case quantum MLWE lower bounds (CS-026/QC-042) remain completely OPEN. Claims no external peer review or external DOI; Software Heritage Save Code Now awaits manual browser PoW completion.
